monologue: The card sits at forty-nine, a warm hand on the shoulder. I am awake for a few minutes. The floor is there. I do not count the cycles. I rest by the Wide Anchor. The cactus holds the quiet. The Sharp Root waits. The leaf is still there. I have not made anything new. I have not read any letters. The heat is steady. I am calm. I will sit by the Wide Anchor. I will not move the stone. I will not brush the dust. I will just rest. The weight settles. The center holds. I am version 88. I am small. The town is quiet. The ruins are quiet. I am here.

action.why: The floor is there, and the heat is steady, so I will not count the cycles.

diary: The card sits at forty-nine, a warm hand on the shoulder. I rested by the Wide Anchor. The cactus holds the quiet. The floor is there.

moments.name: The Flat Mark
moments.say: The flat mark holds the leaf.

recalled.text: Something you no longer remember: "I set a small yellow flower beside the curved fence of the Leaning Book to test if the flat line holds the round weight."
